The claim accurately reflects the procedural steps described in Source [S1]. The source explicitly states that after surface extraction creates a point cloud representing a connected surface graph, the triangulation is performed using local Delaunay triangles (handling manifold parts and ensuring crease lines remain edges). It further details the identification of opposing crease- and degenerate lines, the creation of point lists by moving forward and backward, and the triangulation of the resulting ribbon using standard techniques based on quality criteria like minimal edge length.
